findings.root_cause: The `id` attribute on the button was renamed from `submit-btn` to `submit`, so the CSS id selector `#submit-btn` no longer matches any element in the DOM.
findings.suggestion: Instead of relying on a volatile `id` attribute as the test hook, prefer an accessibility-first contract. Either: (1) use the button's existing semantic role and accessible name — `getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' })` — which is resilient to any future `id` or `className` changes, or (2) add a stable `data-testid="submit-btn"` attribute to the button element in `SubmitButton.tsx` and use `getByTestId('submit-btn')` in the test. If you choose option (2), keep the `data-testid` decoupled from the `id` so that styling/routing concerns cannot accidentally break tests again.
